camel_example: aliyun esa ListUserRatePlanInstances --region cn-hangzhou --Status online --IsShared true --PageSize 500 --InstanceId 'sp-xcdn-96wblslz0000' --SortBy CreateTime --ResourceOwner 1 --PlanNameEn entranceplan --SortOrder asc --RemainingExpireDays 30 --CheckRemainingSiteQuota true --PageNumber 1 --SubscribeType basicplan --PlanType enterprise
description_en: Queries the plan instances purchased by the user and their details
description_zh: 查询该用户已购买的套餐实例及其详细信息
kebab_example: aliyun esa list-user-rate-plan-instances --check-remaining-site-quota true --status online --sort-by CreateTime --sort-order asc --page-number 1 --page-size 500 --instance-id sp-xcdn-96wblslz0000 --remaining-expire-days 30 --subscribe-type basicplan --plan-type enterprise --plan-name-en entranceplan --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListUserRatePlanInstances

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to filter plan instances that have remaining site quota. Valid values:

true: Filters plan instances that have remaining site quota.
false: Queries all plan instances under the user
parameters.help_zh:
是否筛选有剩余站点配额的套餐实例。支持：

true：筛选有剩余站点配额的套餐实例。
false：查询用户下所有的套餐实例
parameters.name: check_remaining_site_quota

parameters.help_en:
The instance status. Valid values:
online: Normal service status.
offline: Expired but not overdue, in an inactive state.
disable: Released.
overdue: Overdue payment
parameters.help_zh:
套餐实例状态。支持：
online：正常服务状态。
offline：到期但未超期，处于不可用的状态。
disable：已释放状态。
overdue：欠费状态
parameters.name: status

parameters.help_en:
The sort field. By default, results are sorted by purchase time. Valid values:

CreateTime: Purchase time.
ExpireTime: Expiration time
parameters.help_zh:
排序字段，默认按照新购时间排序。支持：

CreateTime：新购时间。
ExpireTime：到期时间
parameters.name: sort_by

parameters.help_en:
The sort order. Default value: desc. Valid values:

asc: Ascending order.
desc: Descending order
parameters.help_zh:
排序标识，默认为降序。支持：

asc：升序。
desc：降序
parameters.name: sort_order

parameters.help_en: The page number settings for paging. Default value: 1. Valid values: 1 to 100000
parameters.help_zh: 分页查询时设置的页码。默认值为1。取值范围为：1~100000
parameters.name: page_number

parameters.help_en: The number of entries per page for paging. Valid values: 1 to 500
parameters.help_zh: 分页查询时每页的大小，取值范围 1-500
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en: The plan instance ID. You can obtain this value by calling the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2850189.html operation
parameters.help_zh: 套餐实例ID，可通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2850189.html接口获取
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en: Queries plan instances whose remaining validity period is within the specified number of days. The value must be a positive integer. Unit: days
parameters.help_zh: 查询套餐有效期剩余天数在指定天数以内的套餐实例，只能为正整数，单位为天
parameters.name: remaining_expire_days

parameters.help_en:
The plan subscription type. Valid values:

Free Edition (Chinese mainland): entranceplan
Free Edition (International): entranceplan_intl
Basic Edition: basicplan
Standard Edition: standardplan
Premium Edition: advancedplan
Enterprise Edition: enterpriseplan
parameters.help_zh:
套餐订阅类型。取值范围：

免费版（国内）：entranceplan
免费版（国际）：entranceplan_intl
基础版：basicplan
标准版：standardplan
高级版：advancedplan
企业版：enterpriseplan
parameters.name: subscribe_type

parameters.help_en:
The plan type. Valid values:

normal: fixed edition plan
enterprise: enterprise edition plan
parameters.help_zh:
套餐类型。取值范围:

normal: 固定版套餐
enterprise: 企业版套餐
parameters.name: plan_type
